rationale.B: Quiet Lapinlahdenkatu/Malminkatu residential streets, no major traffic; 3 lights
rationale.C: Lapinlahti then Baana into Kamppi; no traffic, 2 lights; +2 min
rationale.D: Ruoholahdenkatu and Malminrinne with tram rails in the carriageway
rationale.E: Mechelininkatu in traffic briefly plus Eteläinen Rautatiekatu, 7 lights

rationale.G: Ruoholahti paths and Eerikinkatu, 100 m on Malminrinne tram; +3 min
